Google Ads & PPC management

Google Ads Management for Chennai Businesses

Put your business at the top of Google today. We plan, build and manage Google Ads campaigns that focus your budget on the searches most likely to become calls, WhatsApp messages and sales — and show you exactly what they cost.

Plan Your Google AdsCall 94459 78150

01Overview

PPC management focused on enquiries, not just clicks

Google Ads can deliver enquiries within days of launch. It can also burn through a budget quickly if campaigns target the wrong searches, send clicks to a weak page or run without tracking.

Our Google Ads management starts with the basics that make the biggest difference: tight keyword targeting, negative keywords to filter out irrelevant searches, compelling ads, focused landing pages and conversion tracking for calls, forms and WhatsApp clicks. Then we manage and refine the account every month.

Ads work best alongside a strong website and long-term SEO. Unsure which to start with? Read SEO vs Google Ads for small businesses, or see our wider digital marketing services in Chennai.

Google Ads suits

  • Businesses needing leads nowNew launches, seasonal offers or a quiet sales pipeline.
  • Competitive local servicesWhere organic rankings will take time to earn.
  • E-commerce storesShopping campaigns that show products, prices and images.
  • High-value servicesWhere the value of a customer comfortably justifies paid clicks.

02Problems we solve

Why Google Ads campaigns waste money

Broad, untargeted keywords

Ads appearing for loosely related searches attract clicks from people who were never going to buy.

No conversion tracking

Without tracking calls and forms, there's no way to know which keywords bring customers and which just spend money.

Clicks sent to the home page

Paid visitors need a focused page that matches the ad. A generic home page loses many of them.

Set-and-forget management

Campaigns left unchanged drift as competition, costs and search behaviour change.

03What's included

What our Google Ads management includes

Keyword and competitor research

Finding high-intent searches, estimating costs and building negative keyword lists.

Campaign setup

Search, Performance Max, call-focused and Shopping campaigns, structured so each ad group stays relevant.

Ad copy and assets

Headlines, descriptions, sitelinks, and call and location assets written to earn qualified clicks.

Landing pages

Focused landing pages built through our website development service to turn clicks into enquiries.

Conversion tracking

Tracking for calls, form submissions and WhatsApp clicks, so decisions are based on real results.

Monthly optimisation and reports

Bid, budget, keyword and ad improvements, with a clear report on spend, enquiries and cost per enquiry.

04Benefits

What well-managed Google Ads delivers

Paid search puts you in front of people at the moment they search. Managed well, it gives you a predictable, measurable flow of enquiries you can scale up or down.

  • Fast visibilityCampaigns can go live quickly — useful for launches and offers.
  • Control over spendSet daily budgets and focus on the areas and hours that matter.
  • Measurable resultsSee the cost per call, form or sale, not just clicks.
  • Useful search insightsReal search-term data that also informs your SEO and content.

05Our process

How we manage your campaigns

  1. Account review or setup

    We audit an existing account or build a new one with the right structure.

  2. Tracking first

    Conversion tracking for calls, forms and WhatsApp is set up before spend increases.

  3. Launch

    Campaigns go live with tightly themed ad groups and matching landing pages.

  4. Optimise

    We review search terms, add negatives, test ads and adjust bids and budgets.

  5. Report

    A monthly summary of spend, enquiries, cost per enquiry and next steps.

08FAQs

Google Ads questions, answered

Do you manage Google Ads?

Yes. We set up new accounts, take over existing ones and manage campaigns every month — keywords, ads, bids, budgets, landing pages and reporting.

How much should I spend on Google Ads?

It depends on how competitive your keywords are, the areas you target and the value of a customer. We estimate likely click costs during research and recommend a starting budget you're comfortable with, then adjust based on results.

How quickly will I see results?

Ads can start showing as soon as campaigns are approved, and many businesses receive their first enquiries within the first weeks. The first month or two is also a learning period while keywords and bids are refined.

Can you track phone calls from ads?

Yes. We set up tracking for calls from ads and from your website, as well as form submissions and WhatsApp clicks.

Should I run Google Ads or invest in SEO?

Ads bring immediate visibility while you pay; SEO builds longer-term visibility. Many businesses use ads for quick results while SEO grows. Read our guide to SEO vs Google Ads.

Can you target only certain areas of Chennai?

Yes. Campaigns can target a radius around your location, specific areas or PIN codes, or the whole city, and exclude places you don't serve.
